items.title: Samsung Electronics To Establish HVAC Production Line in Korea
items.what_happened: Samsung Electronics today announced that it will establish a FläktGroup HVAC production line in Korea to target the rapidly growing HVAC market, including the production of advanced cooling solutions for AI data centers. The company plans to invest approximately KRW 240 billion (USD 158 million) to build a 21,500m2 HVAC production line at its operations […]
